findings.body:
Empty `matrix=[]` always fails the gate, but the workflow also fires on *every* `labeled` event (`on.pull_request.types: [opened, labeled]`). After a successful `ready` review, adding `bug` / `dependencies` / any other label re-runs `scope` with `should_run=false` → `matrix=[]` → this job goes red and blocks merge again — even though HEAD was already reviewed. `concurrency.cancel-in-progress: true` can also cancel an in-flight ready review when that happens.

Fix: when matrix is empty, only hard-fail if the PR still needs a review. If `ready` is present *and* a prior leg stamped `self-reviewed:*`, treat the prior success as still valid for this HEAD (re-applying `ready` still forces a fresh run via `should_run=true`). Pass `LABELS_JSON` into this step the same way `scope` does.

The comment and error message claim the only empty-matrix path (with secrets configured) is a missing `ready` label. That is incomplete: `should_run=true` still yields `matrix=[]` when no provider secret is set (Anthropic baseline is gated on `HAS_ANTHROPIC`). Maintainers then get told to re-apply `ready`, which will not help.

Consider branching the message: missing `ready` vs. "no eligible provider secret / empty matrix after should_run". Same nuance belongs in the docs recipe snippet.

summary:
## Verdict

Solid fix for the real GitHub gotcha (Skipped required checks don't block merge). The stable-named `Self-review gate` + `if: always()` pattern is the right shape — but as written the gate is **too eager to fail on later non-`ready` label events**, which will re-block merge after a successful review.

## What works

- Correct diagnosis: branch protection treats **Skipped** as non-blocking; only failure/pending gates merge.
- `needs: [scope, self-review]` + `if: always()` is the right way to observe a skipped matrix job.
- Scope-result check is a good fail-closed addition vs. the thinner docs snippet.
- `env:` mapping (not `${{ }}` in the shell string) keeps PR metadata out of command injection.
- Workflow already has explicit `permissions:`; no new third-party actions; CHANGELOG + `TRIGGER_MODES.md` stay in sync with the recipe rename.

## Findings

1. **warning — post-success label churn fails the gate** (`.github/workflows/self-review.yml` empty-matrix branch). Workflow fires on every `labeled` event; only `label == ready` builds a matrix. After a green ready review, adding `bug` / Dependabot labels / etc. re-enters with `matrix=[]` and the gate exits 1, turning the required check red again. Same path can cancel an in-flight ready run via `cancel-in-progress: true`. Fix by treating empty matrix as OK when `ready` is still present *and* a prior leg left `self-reviewed:*` (re-adding `ready` still forces a fresh review).

2. **info — empty-matrix copy over-claims "missing ready"**. `matrix=[]` also happens when `should_run=true` but no provider secret is configured; the error then misdirects maintainers.

## Ops note (not in diff)

Branch protection must require **only** `Self-review gate` and drop the dynamic `Self-review — <provider>` names — called out in the PR body; worth confirming on the repo settings when this lands. Until that switch, this PR's own verification story ("gate red without ready") depends on that config existing.
